Turron - Banana Lumpia
By: Adora's Box
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




4 med. bananas, ripe and firm (apple or banana cooking)
2 tablespoons sugar
1 teaspoon cinnamon
6 lumpia wrappers
Oil for deep frying
6 jackfruit stripes langka (optional)

Preparation

1 Cut banana into 3 parts lengthwise. Place two pieces of bananas and one langka strip on each lumpia wrapper. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on fruits. Wrap in envelope fashion, sealing ends with water. Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serve immediately.
